body.statement: Fix an enumerated finite architecture \(T\), its deterministic tables, and source masses \(p_T\). For every \(i,j\in W\), the minimal structural graph has the directed edge \(i\to j\) if and only if \(Z_{\operatorname{dir}(i,j)}(T,p_T)>0\). For every nonempty child-set index \(C\subseteq W\) and \(j\in C\), its source \(U_C\) is an actual parent of \(j\) if and only if \(Z_{\operatorname{src}(C,j)}(T,p_T)>0\). The endogenous table comparisons include assignments off the observational support, while the exogenous contexts are integrated under \(p_T\). Therefore \(G_S(M_{T,p_T})=G\) if and only if \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\), and this equivalence is unchanged by permutations of source values, response labels, or sources having the same child-set index.
body.justification: This lemma makes actual-edge legality a complete finite polynomial test rather than an informal list of permitted slots.
body.gap: Duarte et al. encode a supplied graph, and Yang et al. encode PAG masks; neither gives an invariant if-and-only-if polynomial test for the exact selected MAG with off-support functional dependence.
body.consumer: The certified bounding procedure uses the equivalence to reject response programs whose zero-mass limits silently delete a parent or confounding source.
